C. To learn English takes time.

【選出 to 加動詞作主語的完整句子。】

D014 · Choose the complete sentence containing a prepositional phrase.

A. Near the window.

B. The plant is near the window.

C. A plant near the window.

【選出包含位置片語的完整陳述。】

D015 · In the exchange “Where did you wait?” which is a natural short answer?

A. Because I waited.

B. At the station.

C. The station which.

【在所給對話中,選出自然回答地點的短語。】

D016 · Which is a complete statement about a previously mentioned photo?

A. The photo, which was blurry.

B. A blurry photo.

C. The photo, which was blurry, was deleted.

【選出有補充關係子句,而且整句完整的寫法。】

D017 · Which is an ordinary direct question rather than a relative noun phrase?

A. Who lives here?

B. The person who lives here.

C. The house where she lives.

【選出直接發問的完整句子。】

D018 · Which sentence may begin with And and still have a full clause?

A. And then a long walk.

B. And then we walked home.

C. And after the lesson.

【選出 And 後仍有完整主句的寫法。】

D019 · Choose the full clause following But.

A. But we stayed.

B. But very cold.

C. But after midnight.

【選出 But 後有完整陳述的一句。】

D020 · Choose a complete conditional statement.

A. If it rains tomorrow.

B. Unless the rain stops.

C. If it rains tomorrow, we will stay in.

【選出包括條件和主要結果的完整句子。】

D021 · Choose the complete although-sentence.

A. Although the room was small.

B. Although the room was small, it was comfortable.

C. Despite the small room.

【選出同時交代讓步情況和主要事情的句子。】

D022 · Which has a main clause after Even if?

A. Even if it is expensive.

B. Even if he is late.

C. Even if it is expensive, we will buy it.

【選出即使有某種情況,仍說明結果的完整句子。】

D023 · Which uses a whether-clause as the subject of a complete sentence?

A. Whether she comes matters.

B. Whether she comes.

C. If she comes.

【選出 whether 子句作主語,而且後面有主要動詞的句子。】

D024 · Which is complete even though it begins with What?

A. What she said.

B. What she said surprised everyone.

C. The words she said.

【選出 what 子句作主語的完整句。】

D025 · Which is a complete past statement, not just a noun phrase?

A. The door closed at six.

B. The door closed by the guard.

C. The door near the gate.

【選出可以獨立說明大門何時關上的完整句。】

D026 · In an informal conversation, which is a natural acceptance of “Shall we go?”

A. Why not?

B. Because when.

C. The leaving.

【在對話中,選出自然表示同意的簡短答覆。】

D027 · Which is a normal sign rather than an incorrectly written full paragraph sentence?

A. No parking.

B. Parking no.

C. No park you.

【選出自然的英文告示寫法。】

D028 · Which is a conventional independent wish or regret expression?

A. If only I had more time!

B. If I had more time.

C. Unless I had more time.

【選出可自然獨立表達願望的句子。】

D029 · Which is a complete negative statement?

A. Not anybody here.

B. Nobody answered.

C. With nobody here.

【選出完整的否定陳述。】

D030 · Which is a comma splice, not a fragment?

A. Because we arrived late.

B. We arrived late, the show had begun.

C. After the show.

【選出兩個完整主句只用逗號連接的問題句。】

D031 · Which is a run-on rather than a fragment?

A. The bus came we got on.

B. Because the bus came.

C. After the bus.

【選出兩個完整句子沒有合適標點分開的寫法。】

D032 · Which correctly joins two independent clauses with a semicolon?

A. The show ended; because it was late.

B. The show ended; we went home.

C. The show ended; after midnight.

【選出適合用分號連接兩個完整主句的句子。】

D033 · Which is a full sentence with a reduced time clause and a command?

A. When ready.

B. When ready, press the button.

C. Being ready.

【選出有完整命令的縮短時間句。】

D034 · Which is an ordinary complete weather statement?

A. Is raining outside.

B. Raining outside.

C. It is raining outside.

【選出普通完整的下雨陳述。】

D035 · Which is an ordinary complete existential statement?

A. There are three chairs.

B. Are three chairs.

C. Three chairs over there.

【選出用 there are 介紹有東西的完整句子。】

B｜按指定方法改正(D036–D060)

D036 · Add only the subject I to make a complete past statement.

Went to the library yesterday.

【只加 I,說明我昨天到過圖書館。】

答案:________________________

D037 · Add the appropriate present form of be, keeping every other word.

The soup too hot.

【只補合適的 be,說湯現在太熱。】

答案:________________________

D038 · Add the appropriate present form of be for the plural subject.

They waiting outside.

【只補合適的 be,說他們現在正等候。】

答案:________________________

D039 · Make a passive past statement about the parcels by adding one word.

The parcels _____ delivered yesterday.

【加一個字,表示包裹昨天被送到。】

答案:________________________

D040 · Join the time fragment to the following main clause, placing a comma after left.

After we left. The lights went out.

【把時間子句放在前面,並在 left 後用逗號接主句。】

答案:________________________

D041 · Combine the two parts, keeping Because at the beginning.

Because it rained. We stayed home.

【保留 Because 在句首,合成一句。】

答案:________________________

D042 · Combine the two parts, keeping the order and using a comma after tired.

Although she was tired. She continued working.

【保留原本先後位置,在 tired 後用逗號。】

答案:________________________

D043 · Add exactly is Ben to complete the statement.

The boy who called.

【在句尾加 is Ben,其他字不改。】

答案:________________________

D044 · Remove only the first word to make the activity the subject.

# PART X — Final Coverage Check｜學完後自己檢查

學完後,你應該能自己回答:

**完整句:**我能找到主要句,知道完整句不一定很長。

**缺主語:**我能找出到底誰做事,也不會替原文自行加人物。

**缺動詞:**我能分辨普通過去式、-ing、過去分詞、被動及完成式需要甚麼動詞。

**從屬句:**我能分辨 because、if、unless、when、while、although、so that 等字帶出的部分。

**關係句:**我知道 the girl who called 雖然有 called,卻可能仍只是名詞短語。

**片語:**我能分辨名詞、介詞、分詞、to 和 -ing 短語怎樣依附另一句。

**並列:**我知道 And、But、Or 開頭不一定錯,重點是後面有沒有完整主要句。

**修補:**我能選擇加主語、加動詞、合併、刪連接字或重新安排句子,而不改變原意。

**標點:**我知道分號或句號不能替代缺少的主要句,也知道 comma splice 不是片段。

**短句:**我不會把 Stop!、Who called?、What a lovely day! 等自然說法全部當成錯誤。

**對話:**我能理解 At school.、Not yet.、Because I was tired. 在合適問答中為甚麼可以使用。

**不同文體:**我知道標題、告示、履歷、新聞標題、廣告和小說有自己的簡短寫法。

**較少見形式:**我能認出 If only ...!、As if!、The sooner, the better. 等特殊結構。

**不確定時:**我會先看整句的用途和上下文,不會用一條過度簡化的規則亂判斷。

最後五個實用問題

這組字在正式陳述中有沒有主要句?

主要句的主語和動詞在哪裏?

有沒有從屬字或修飾短語,令我誤把它當成主要句?

這段文字其實是在回答問題、標示物品,還是刻意作感嘆?

如果要修改,怎樣才能最少改字又保留人物、時間及意思?

最後提醒:學會 sentence fragments,不是把所有短句變長,也不是把每個 because 後面都加一個虛構結果。最重要的是分清普通完整句、需要修補的片段、自然的省略,以及不同文體有意使用的短句。當資訊不足時,要先確認原意,再決定怎樣寫。
